subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12). PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics) and TRS (transition). From PROJ-DYM: AFI (affinity insight). From TRS: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: C-INFO (composite information) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From C-INFO: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From MT-INFO: POL-DYM (political dynamics).
